mailBills.title: Bills found in mail
mailBills.description: When a Gmail search found new bills to review as suggested expenses.

mailReply.title: Replies to your mails
mailReply.description: When someone answers a mail you sent from the assistant or linked to a project (only your own mailbox).

page.title: Integrations
page.description: Connect WickedHome to other services. Everything works without them; each one adds data or saves typing.
page.footer: Keys and tokens stay on the server and are never shown in the app.

settingsLink.title: Integrations
settingsLink.text: Connections to other services have their own page.

google.title: Google
google.description: Your own Google account: your calendars on the household calendar, bills from Gmail as suggested expenses, and Drive folders in Documents.
google.connectFailed: Connecting to Google didn't start. Try again.
google.connectedSince: Connected since {{date}}. Everyone in the household connects their own account.
google.reconnectHint: Google no longer accepts the consent you gave (it was revoked or expired). Reconnect to continue syncing.

disconnectConfirm.title: Disconnect Google?
disconnectConfirm.description: WickedHome withdraws its access at Google and forgets your calendars, the events it copied, your pending mail suggestions and your linked Drive folders. Nothing in your Google account is deleted.
disconnectConfirm.driveFiles_one: Warning: {{count}} bill document is stored in your Drive. It stays there, but can't be opened in WickedHome until you connect again with the same Google account, and new bill documents are saved on the server meanwhile.
disconnectConfirm.driveFiles_other: Warning: {{count}} bill documents are stored in your Drive. They stay there, but can't be opened in WickedHome until you connect again with the same Google account, and new bill documents are saved on the server meanwhile.

google.wrongOrigin: Connecting only works from the address Google sends you back to. Open WickedHome at
google.privacy: WickedHome asks Google only for what the feature you turn on needs. Your tokens are stored encrypted on the server.

return.denied: You didn't allow access at Google. Nothing was connected.
return.expired: That took too long. Start connecting again.
return.error: Google couldn't be connected. Try again.

setup.intro: Google isn't set up on the server yet. The owner does this once, then everyone connects their own account:
setup.key: Run this on the server to make an encryption key for the tokens…
setup.keyEnv: …and put it in .env (never change it afterwards, or everyone has to reconnect).
setup.project: In Google Cloud Console, create a project and enable the Google Calendar API, Gmail API and Google Drive API.
setup.consent: OAuth consent screen: External, add the household's Google accounts as users, then publish the app ("In production"), so connections don't expire after 7 days.
setup.client: Credentials → Create OAuth client ID → Web application, with authorised redirect URI {{uri}}. Put its ID and secret in .env:
setup.restart: Restart the app to load the new settings.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.description: Show the Google calendars you choose on the household calendar, synced every 15 minutes. Optionally publish household events to Google.

calendar_publish.title: Publish to Google Calendar
calendar_publish.description: Push household events of chosen categories to one of your calendars.

gmail.title: Gmail
gmail.description: Finds invoices from known senders (Fluvius, Telenet…) and suggests them as expenses with the PDF, and lets the assistant search and read your own mail when you ask. Read-only; nothing is added without your tap.

drive.title: Drive
drive.description: Link Drive folders into Documents, open or import their files, and save documents to your Drive.

gmail_send.title: Send mail from the assistant
gmail_send.description: The assistant can write mails for you (e.g. a quote request to a contractor). Each one is shown on a card first: you tap Send or Save as draft.

calendar.none: No calendars found in this Google account.
calendar.syncFailed: Syncing with Google failed. Try again later.

publish.title: Publish household events
publish.description: One-way: household events of the categories you choose appear in one of your Google calendars (so phones show them). Changes in Google are not copied back.
publish.saved: Publishing saved; new and changed events follow within seconds
publish.turnedOff: Publishing turned off; published events are removed from Google

mail.scanFailed: Searching your mail failed. Try again later.
mail.pending_one: {{count}} suggested expense waiting on the Expenses page
mail.pending_other: {{count}} suggested expenses waiting on the Expenses page
mail.privacy: The bill search reads only mails from these senders with a PDF and keeps the amount, due date and payment reference, never the mail. The assistant reads other mail only when you ask it to, and only your own mailbox.

send.title: Send mail from the assistant
send.description: Lets the assistant send mails or save them as Gmail drafts from your account, always after you tapped Send or Save as draft on its card. Google asks once to allow it.
send.on: On: mails are sent or saved as drafts only after your tap.

rules.title: Bill senders
rules.description: Mail from these senders with a PDF attached becomes a suggested expense. Shared by the whole household.
rules.sendersHint: Addresses or domains, one per line (e.g. fluvius.be or facturen@luminus.be).
rules.invalidSender: Use an address or a domain, like fluvius.be.

drive.privacy: A linked folder is visible (read-only) to everyone in the household, through your connection. Unlinking never deletes anything in Drive.
drive.pickDescription: Open the folder you want to link, then link it. It shows up in Documents for the whole household.

suggestions.title: Suggested from mail
suggestions.description: Bills found in Gmail. Accept to add them as an expense with the PDF attached.
suggestions.accepted: Expense added; the PDF is in Documents
suggestions.attachFailed: The expense was added, but the PDF couldn't be fetched from Gmail.

link.notCreated: This payment doesn't exist yet: it is created when you link.
link.noMatches: No likely matches. Search the expenses or pick a recurring expense.
link.occurrenceTitle: Which payment of {{payee}} is this mail for?
link.occurrenceHint: The payment nearest to the mail's due date is picked.
link.noChanges: The expense already matches the mail.
link.paidWarning: Already paid on {{date}}: ticking the amount or due date changes what was paid.
link.recurringHint: For {{payee}} and its upcoming unpaid payments.
link.rememberHint: Next mails come pre-matched to the right payment; you still confirm with a tap.
link.pdf: The PDF {{name}} is attached to the expense.
link.linked: Linked to {{payee}}; the PDF is attached
link.linkedNoPdf: Linked to {{payee}}, but the PDF couldn't be fetched from Gmail.

driveFolder.title: Linked Drive folders
driveFolder.unavailable: Not available: {{name}} needs to reconnect Google.
driveFolder.loadError: This Drive folder couldn't be opened.
driveFolder.unlinkConfirm: Unlink "{{name}}"? Nothing is deleted in Drive.
driveFolder.notDownloadable: This kind of Google file can only be opened in Drive.
driveFolder.saveFailed: Saving to Drive failed. Is Drive turned on under Integrations?

driveStorage.title: Bill documents in Google Drive
driveStorage.description: Files attached to expenses and PDFs from mail suggestions are saved in a Google Drive folder instead of on the server. They still open in WickedHome.
driveStorage.notConfigured: Set up Google first (see the Google card above).
driveStorage.needsDrive: To choose a folder, turn on Drive for your Google account. Bills are then saved in your Drive, for the whole household.
driveStorage.createHint: Created in your My Drive. You can move or rename it in Drive later; it keeps working.
driveStorage.createAndUse: Create folder and save bills there
driveStorage.pickHint: Use a folder you already made, e.g. "Facturen".
driveStorage.pickScope: Adding files to a folder you made needs one more permission: access to your Drive. Google then shows that WickedHome isn't verified by Google (Advanced → Go to WickedHome). WickedHome only adds bill documents there and never deletes anything unless you turn that on below.
driveStorage.pickDescription: Open the folder bill documents should go to, then choose it.
driveStorage.openAFolder: Open a folder to choose it
driveStorage.saved: Bill documents are now saved in "{{name}}"
driveStorage.moveHint: Each copy is checked in Drive (size and checksum) before the copy on the server is removed.
driveStorage.waiting_one: {{count}} document is waiting to move to Drive (kept on the server meanwhile). It's retried automatically.
driveStorage.waiting_other: {{count}} documents are waiting to move to Drive (kept on the server meanwhile). They're retried automatically.
driveStorage.failed_one: {{count}} of them failed several times; still retried, less often.
driveStorage.failed_other: {{count}} of them failed several times; still retried, less often.
driveStorage.deleteInDriveHint: When a bill document is deleted for good in WickedHome (emptied from the trash), move it to Drive's trash too. Off: Drive keeps it.

paused.disconnected_one: Paused: {{name}} disconnected Google. New bill documents are saved on the server. The {{count}} document already in Drive stays there but can't be opened in WickedHome until {{name}} connects again with the same Google account.
paused.disconnected_other: Paused: {{name}} disconnected Google. New bill documents are saved on the server. The {{count}} documents already in Drive stay there but can't be opened in WickedHome until {{name}} connects again with the same Google account.
paused.needsReconnect: Paused: Google needs {{name}} to reconnect. New bill documents wait on the server and move to Drive afterwards.
paused.missingScope: Paused: {{name}} no longer allows WickedHome to add files to this folder. New bill documents wait on the server.

stopConfirm.title: Stop saving bills to Drive?
stopConfirm.description: New bill documents are saved on the server again. Documents already in Drive stay there and keep opening in WickedHome; nothing is deleted.

driveStorage.stopped: Bill documents are saved on the server again

google-calendar.title: Google Calendar sync
google-calendar.description: Copies new and changed events of the chosen Google calendars and publishes household events, for everyone who connected Google.

google-mail.title: Bills from Gmail
google-mail.description: Searches the connected mailboxes for invoices from the bill senders and adds suggested expenses.

mail-replies.title: Replies to linked mails
mail-replies.description: Looks in each person's own Gmail for new replies to mails linked to projects, every 10 minutes.

project.title: Mail
project.description: Your own mails about this project; replies come as a notification.
project.label: Mails about this project
project.empty: No mails linked yet. Ask the assistant to mail a contact about this project.

preview.textFailed: The mail text couldn't be read from Gmail.
